Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Audit each candidate equally; C0 is not privileged and later candidates are not automatically wrong. Distinguish ANSWER FORM from FACT. Year-only and full-date strings can have different granularity but may describe the same event. Positive subject-relation-object assignments are support, not counterevidence. For every date check birth versus death versus award/publication; for every artist check performer versus author/producer/chart. Multiple allowed entities may have separate answers.
